title: Synthyrion proofs: bounded-proof results, timing-analysis tables and the proof engine
description: Results, checker outputs and a runnable bounded proof engine behind the Synthyrion Core L5 kernel: the panic-freedom census of 5,659 kernel decision functions, the worst-case-timing registry of 140 kernel entry points with the tables a bound is computed from, the bounded-proof statements with their domains and outcomes, SHA-512 fingerprints of the checker outputs with the commit they were measured on, and the proof engine with a small subject. The repository contains no kernel source. Accompanies the architecture and security report and the methods report by the same authors. These are tested, bounded and panic-free results; there is no whole-kernel functional-correctness proof and no certification.
